sources_tried: Manufacturer locators (Bobrick, ASI, Scranton, Bradley, Hadrian, Metpar, General Partitions, Ampco): no San Antonio dealer or installer locator turned up in search. Bobrick's published case study PDF worked and named DEA Specialties as the installing distributor (rep: Peerless Marketing Group, Dallas). Searches for Hadrian, Scranton and Global Partitions dealers returned only national online sellers.
The Blue Book (thebluebook.com): blocked, iProView pages return 403. Search snippets showed no San Antonio toilet partition subcontractor.

Procore Network: worked (network.procore.com interior-specialties and toilet-bath-accessories pages, page 1 only). It gave Bernco and Azteca. EP Prime is El Paso-based and Aztec Specialtiez is in Buda, both outside the radius, so they were skipped.
BuildingConnected: not reached (no public results in search).

Web search (toilet partition installation San Antonio, bathroom partition installers, Division 10 contractor, New Braunfels/Schertz/Cibolo/Converse/Seguin/Boerne variants): worked. Main source of candidates.

San Antonio Water System bid tabulations (apps.saws.org PDFs for HDPE restroom partition purchase-and-install): worked. They gave the bidders All Pro General Construction, F.M.O., Azteca Designs and LMC.
BBB: worked for Bernco Group. Yelp: no San Antonio partition listings came up in search.

Company sites: deaspecialties.com, rg-installation.org, subcontractorsanantonio.com (Hohmann), berncogroup.com, divtenconstruction.com and xpblocker.com worked. centraltexasinstallationspecialties.com did not resolve (DNS fail; it would need to be allowed in the session's network settings). rginstallation.com is a parked domain.

Thumbtack, MapQuest, governmentcontracts.us and hireveterans.com: returned empty or 404 pages, so their facts came from search snippets only. downtobid.com: 429 rate limited. accessories.toiletpartitions.com: 403.

Skipped as out of area or not installers: One Point Partitions and US Partitions (national online sellers; One Point's San Antonio site is a delivery terminal that does not install), BC Partitions (Houston), Texas Specialties & Installation (Grand Prairie), Innergy Interiors (El Paso), Southwest Solutions Group (has a San Antonio office, but toilet partitions are shown only for its Seattle office), Klinger Associates (no installation evidence).
